neighbours.label: the word piece 'aste'/'aster'/'asted' when it is split off a short prefix (t|aster, ro|aster, -w|aste, dism|asted), as against the same or similar words that are a single token (toaster, master, waste)
fire: The coffee roaster in our street sells beans from Ethiopia.
Our team needs a skilled taster for the new range of cheeses.
The council collects yard-waste bins every second Tuesday.
Old phones count as e-waste and must not go in the normal bin.
The rumour was spread by a local boaster who loved attention.
Two shots dismasted the frigate and it surrendered within an hour.
The magazine ran a piece called Make Haste about faster checkouts.
She hired a professional tea taster to judge the blends.
quiet: The coffee machine in our street sells beans from Ethiopia.
Our team needs a skilled master for the new range of cheeses.
The council collects garden waste bins every second Tuesday.
Old phones count as rubbish and must not go in the normal bin.
The rumour was spread by a local plasterer who loved attention.
Two shots damaged the frigate and it surrendered within an hour.
The magazine ran a piece called Hurry Up about faster checkouts.
She bought a new toaster to go with the kettle.
